lines.text: David cries out for God to save him, because the waters are up to his neck.
David's enemies hate him without cause, and zeal for God's house has made him a stranger to his sisters.
David wept and fasted and wore sackcloth, and then he prayed to the LORD for a time of favor.
David asks God to rescue him from the mire, but he finds comforters who give him wine to drink.

wrong_details.true: he found no one to comfort him

lines.text: David will praise God in song, and God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah.
